description: Source code for Odoo wiki module, defining classes for Wiki pages, groups, links, and history with associated methods.

classes.name: Wiki
classes.description: Represents a Wiki page with content, metadata, and version history.

classes.name: WikiGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of Wiki pages, with hierarchical structure and metadata.

classes.name: GroupLink
classes.description: Represents links between Wiki groups and menu actions.

classes.name: History
classes.description: Tracks revisions and changes made to Wiki pages, including diff generation.

methods.name: onchange_group_id
methods.description: Updates content and section when the group ID of a Wiki page changes.

methods.name: copy_data
methods.description: Creates a copy of a Wiki page, resetting the wiki_id.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Wiki page and logs initial content in history.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Updates a Wiki page and logs changes in history.

methods.name: getDiff
methods.description: Generates an HTML diff between two revision histories.
